2027-05-01.name: Daily #212
hints: The beam must turn three times, one mass per turn. Bend it onto the seeds in the order it reaches them.
The marked sphere holds the first mass, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam.

A heavy mass a shadow-width from the beam, about a quarter of the way along the star's beam, turns it toward the second mass. Then a heavy mass one and a half shadow-widths from the new beam, before the first seed, turns it back onto the first seed. Then a heavy mass a shadow-width from the new beam, just past the first seed, turns it again through the last two seeds.
